A [[Gotal]] [[Gender|male]] '''beggar''' resided on the [[planet]] [[Oba Diah]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. He encountered [[Ahsoka Tano]] and the [[Martez family|Martez sisters]], [[Trace Martez|Trace]] and [[Rafa Martez|Rafa]], who were attempting to [[Escape from Oba Diah|escape]] [[Prison|imprisonment]] by the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. The beggar asked the fugitives for [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], but Rafa Martez dismissed him. After learning that the criminal syndicate was searching for Tano and the Martez sisters, the Gotal informed the [[Pyke]]s of their location.<ref name="Dangerous Debt" />
